newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Yanase to sell GM's Saturn cars.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Yanase to sell GM's Saturn cars.

text.p: Yanase & Co Ltd, a major Japanese dealer in foreign cars, said on Thursday it had formed a wholly owned subsidiary in Tokyo to sell and provide after-sales service for General Motors Corp's Saturn cars.
It said the new company, Yanase Saturn KK, would start selling Saturn models through an outlet in western Tokyo and another in neighbouring Kanagawa Prefecture next April.
Yanase Saturn also plans to build one outlet in Yokohama and another in Hachioji, a Tokyo suburb, a Yanase spokesman said.

On Wednesday, Saturn Japan, a division of General Motors Japan Ltd reponsible for importing and distributing the cars, said they would be sold at 14 outlets in Japan from next April and through a total of 20 outlets by the end of 1997.
The outlets include those planned by Yanase.
Yanase has been importing and selling GM-made cars in Japan since 1915.
